turns.text: Behind the technical name Deep Blue, what intuitive problem were researchers confronting?
Computer chess had advanced for decades through better search, evaluation, and hardware. Deep Blue made that lineage visible on a global stage.
That sounds like a promising direction. What mechanism actually makes it work?

The machine searched many candidate moves deeply, pruning losing branches and scoring positions with chess knowledge. The key mechanism is Specialized chess search hardware, which links the source material to the visible demo behavior.
Why did the idea outlive one paper or experiment? What did later researchers actually inherit?

Experts generally treat Deep Blue as a landmark in specialized search, evaluation, and high-performance game AI. Its long-term legacy is shaping public expectations for AI milestones and serving as a reference point for later game systems such as AlphaGo.
Deep Blue mattered not only as a result, but as a method that later researchers could test, adapt, and extend.
